svg.title: निदान बोर्ड — the diagnosis board
svg.desc: दादाजी's cork board from the bank: wooden frame, four brass corner pins, a faded notice strip at the top. Twenty fixed slots round one centre card; a card never changes slot. Red wool (लाल ऊन) runs from each card's pin to the centre card. The centre card is covered by a slip with a question mark until scene 2.8, then reads मिथ्यादर्शन. दादाजी's own card sits face down, without a thread, in the bottom screen-left slot until scene 6.8. Card titles are working titles; slots and counts are fixed. States left to right: ch1 (5 cards, 5 threads), ch2 (9, 9), ch3 (13, 13; unchanged through chapter 4), ch5 (14, 14), ch6 (17, 17, plus अर्जुन's two threads running outward to blame slips on the frame), ch7 (after 7.1: 19 face-up cards, 21 threads, all to the centre), final (after 7.5: 20 cards, 22 threads, every slot full). Anatomy of a single card: nidan-card.svg.
